about: A Go library for WebDAV, CalDAV and CardDAV file and calendar servers.

prs.title: Copying a folder on the WebDAV server works
prs.broken: Copying a folder with files in it failed with a server error. When copying over an existing folder, that folder's files were already deleted by the time it failed.
prs.changed: Each file and subfolder is now copied to its own place under the new folder, keeping its permissions.
prs.matters: Folder copies work, and a failed copy no longer wipes out a backup folder.

prs.title: Copying or moving a file onto itself no longer deletes it
prs.broken: Copying or moving a file or folder to its own path deleted it. The server removed the destination first, which was the source, and then failed.
prs.changed: I made the server refuse a copy or move onto the same path, as the WebDAV standard says.
prs.matters: A slip in a file manager or sync tool can no longer wipe out data.
